result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with nothing left. In your example, WH-1 now lists only "Bolt 10".

The change is one SQL condition, `AND s.quantity > 0`, in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Asking for the quantity of nuts in WH-1 still answers 0. That lookup is a separate query, `findStockQuantity`, which I didn't touch. The only caller of `listStockByWarehouse` is `StockService`.

I ran the full test suite with `mvn -q -o test` and it passed. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.
